hooks.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run lint 2>&1 && npm run build 2>&1 && npm run test 2>&1; else echo 'package.json 없음 — skip'; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+(-f|--force)|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+checkout\s+(--\s+)?\.|git\s+clean\s+-[fd]|git\s+stash\s+drop|DROP\s+TABLE'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 1; fi
